title: AccuWeather Forecast: Cloud cover moves in overnight; Coastal Flood Advisory through Saturday - ABC7 Bay Area
text:
AccuWeather Forecast: Cloud cover moves in overnight; Coastal Flood Advisory through Saturday - ABC7 San Francisco 
 24/7 Live San Francisco East Bay South Bay Peninsula North Bay WEATHER 
 AccuWeather Forecast: Cloud cover moves in overnight; Coastal Flood Advisory through Saturday 
 Thursday, October 29, 2026 12:19AM 
 ABC7 Eyewitness News weather anchor Delaney White has the AccuWeather forecast. Takeaway of the Day Temperatures remain cool today in the 60s and low 70s across the region. Overnight lows will drop into the 40s and 50s a cloud cover moves in. A Coastal Flood Advisory remains in effect through Saturday at 6 p.m. Flooding is possible in coastal areas and areas along the bay shoreline.
 A Look Ahead Temperatures will continue to cool tomorrow with cloudier skies in the forecast. Rain is possible on Halloween. The storm track has shifted north, showing the potential for some very light rain in the South Bay on Halloween. Rainfall amounts will likely total less than a tenth of an inch.
